acceptance_predicates.description: A named one-process liveness configuration is distinct from the full stress configuration and retains all lifecycle safety invariants and EventualCompletion.
Every removed dimension has a checked mapping to a declared focused model or an existing source-only concrete test, with explicit non-claims.
An old vendor can perform a transitional sync, then the installed new vendor removes the retired configuration atomically and verifies the exact development snapshot.

definition_of_done: The merged Coordinator source has locally verified formal, unit, static, and vendor-migration evidence.
The exact development vendor passes the bounded pr-publication formal tier within its declared budget.
The task records locally reproducible bounded-model evidence.

inputs.description: The lifecycle TLA model, full configuration, and reduced release-tier configuration.
The Coordinator vendor snapshot updater and an existing pre-AR-0101 state snapshot.

outputs.description: A local exact-candidate bounded-model receipt and coverage map.

gates.description: Locally reproducible functional and bounded-model evidence is required; external systems are supplementary only.
